_README: Copy this file to roster.json and put your own people and agents in it.
roster.json is gitignored on purpose: who your team is should never conflict
with a git pull. This example file IS tracked, so you always have something to
The board works without this file at all — a fresh clone renders using the
example roster in core/identity.mjs. Setting it up is something you do when you
want your own names and colours, not a step between you and a working board.
Keys are free strings and nothing validates against this file. An author with
no entry here still works: they render in grey, under their own name. So you
can add a seat by just using it, and fill in its light later.
Each seat needs a name and a color (hex). glyph is optional and defaults to a
neutral mark. A malformed seat is skipped, not fatal — one stray comma should
